procedure: RiskScorer.score(function_source, language) from a fresh interpreter; 25 repetitions per function after one warm-up call, 6 labeled functions, 150 samples per run
hardware_context: same host, sequential runs, no other load reported
note: The first run of a process is slower (XGBoost artifact load + first tree-sitter parse per language); steady-state medians are ~2.1-2.8 ms per function.
